```powershell
npm.cmd run build:frontend
```

Tes products:e2e memerlukan preview server di 48174. Production preview dapat diuji pada port 48175 dengan CINEVA_PRODUCTS_ORIGIN. Playwright memakai headless bundled Chromium, isolated browser context dan guard yang menolak external/backend requests. Data dummy tidak berasal dari export data asli. Laporan menyimpan skenario E2E, checks, screenshots, hashes CSS dan status backend.

Theme host saat ini memaksa light melalui ThemeProvider lama; tidak diubah. Standalone preview memiliki tombol terang/gelap khusus untuk menguji CSS dark tokens existing. Tes dark preview bukan klaim theme toggle host lama sudah diperbaiki.

Hasil akhir dirujuk ke `3.Knowledge/reports/dual_product_2026_10_18/`: contracts-results.txt, checks.json, e2e-results.json, production-e2e-results.json, validation.json dan Excel. Full app typecheck debt dipisahkan dari diagnostic feature baru. Build warnings legacy tidak disembunyikan.

Hasil terverifikasi: 9 domain tests, 17 shared contract regressions, 19 skenario A/B pada development dan build produksi, serta 16 component regressions lulus. Lint feature 0 error/0 warning dan 0 diagnostic type baru; full aplikasi masih 101 diagnostics. Empat baseline CSS/theme/preset unchanged, backend source unchanged. text:
# Cineva folder separation and retrieval index

Date: 2026-10-14 (Asia/Jakarta). Status: folder move, static path validation and frontend production build completed. [Excel report](../reports/folder_restructure_2026_10_14/Cineva_Folder_Restructure.xlsx).

## Architectural impact

Workspace now follows the HOTS Kantor top-level convention. Backend moved as a complete app, preserving its internal relative paths. This is preparation for shared packages and modular platform upgrades; it does not convert business controllers into the new HOTS programs/module.json layout yet. No API route, marketplace logic, EAV contract or DB mutation was changed.

```text
Cineva-V2-/
  1.Frontend/HOTS/                existing frontend
  2.Backend/Integrated-API/       existing backend + .env + public
  3.Knowledge/
    architecture/                current structural decisions
    tools/                       config-driven indexing engine and search CLI
    scripts/legacy/              original one-time DB repair scripts
    scripts/restructure_2026_10_14/  move evidence and report builder
    reports/                     audit and restructure workbooks
  4. Refrence/                   existing references, unchanged
  package.json                   workspace commands, no app dependencies
  README.md
```

## Old to current path mapping

| Before | Current | Reason |
|---|---|---|
| `1, fontend/HOTS` | `1.Frontend/HOTS` | Match Kantor naming and fix spelling |
| `3. knowledge` | `3.Knowledge` | Match knowledge entry convention |
| `app`, `bootstrap`, `config`, `controller`, `core`, `jobs`, `middleware`, `public`, `routers`, `script`, `server`, `service` | `2.Backend/Integrated-API/<same folder>` | App remains one relative-import unit |

heading: Old to current path mapping
text:
| `.env`, `index.js`, `ecosystem.config.js`, backend package/lock, pack script, original README | `2.Backend/Integrated-API/<same file>` | App runtime ownership |
| `fix_schema.js`, `tmp-repair-dash.js` | `3.Knowledge/scripts/legacy/<same file>` | One-time maintenance stays outside deploy app |

Git stays at workspace root. References and `.continue` stay at their existing locations. No deletion of original source files; moves are recorded in `scripts/restructure_2026_10_14/before.json` with old/new path, size and SHA256. Earlier audit files keep pre-restructure paths as historical evidence. The audit builder now resolves current paths when rerun.

## Launch and packaging contracts

- Root `npm start` and `dev:backend` delegate to `npm --prefix 2.Backend/Integrated-API`, so the backend working directory remains its app root.
- `.env` moved byte-for-byte with backend. The backend still loads `.env.local` from its own root if provided.
- PM2 config now sets `cwd: __dirname`. Existing name/instance/process settings remain unchanged.
- Both pack BATs enter their own folder through `cd /d "%~dp0"` before building/packing.
- Frontend directly imports `uuid` in UnifiedFormStructureEditor and StudioPage but originally omitted it from its package. After separation, clean frontend build failed to resolve it. The frontend now declares `uuid` 8.3.2 explicitly, matching the existing backend lockfile version, so its dependency does not rely on a parent/backend install. No editor behavior changed.
- Existing backend `build` still refers to missing `build.js` in its original package. This pre-existing limitation was not repaired by a folder move; source pack BAT remains the existing packaging mechanism.
- Repair scripts have updated backend imports and explicit backend dotenv path. They were not executed, and DDL/data mutation behavior has not been audited for safe execution.

## Index and retrieval architecture

`tools/index.config.json` owns app scopes, directory exclusions and chunk line limits. `index-engine.mjs` owns file scanning and static extraction. `index-workspace.mjs` writes knowledge/code manifests and app maps; `search-index.mjs` queries those outputs. They do not import runtime controllers or connect to a database.

Outputs:

- `FILE_MAP.md`: app roots and knowledge pointers.
- `code_manifest.json`: exact source paths, SHA256, line counts, literal imports and literal route definitions.
- `knowledge_manifest.json`: documentation paths, titles, headings and SHA256.
- `knowledge_chunks.jsonl`: document text with source hash and citation line ranges.
- `APP_MAP.md` per app: file-level navigation.

Exclusions include `.env`, key material, upload/public, generated/build, dependencies, archive, one-time legacy scripts and index outputs. Retrieval uses case-insensitive all-term matching on file/import/route metadata and document chunks. This is a local retrieval foundation, not a semantic/vector RAG system. Regex extraction may include comments and misses computed/dynamic route strings; read exact source after locating candidates. Draft schema remains draft; a database table mention is not authoritative DDL.

```powershell

heading: Index and retrieval architecture
text:
npm.cmd run knowledge:index
npm.cmd run knowledge:search -- jobmarketplace
rg -n "approveApplicant" 2.Backend/Integrated-API
rg -n "JobMarketplace" 1.Frontend/HOTS/src
```

## Verification and rollback

Initial move check: 1,651 captured files; 1,646 byte-identical after move; five intentional support edits (PM2 cwd, two BAT cwd changes and two repair-script imports). The subsequent frontend dependency repair additionally changes its package and lockfile; final counts are in after.json and Excel. No missing files. All 586 static relative-require checks retain their before/after resolution status. The 56 unresolved baseline references are existing source/legacy/comment matches; the restructure adds no unresolved references in this check. Full runtime module resolution is not implied by regex checks.

Final move check: 1,644 byte-identical and seven intentional support/dependency changes. Index contains 687 source files (474 frontend including MJS/CJS scope; 213 backend), eight knowledge documents and 105 chunks. All indexed source/doc paths exist; forbidden path check finds zero. Search for `approveApplicant` and `takeJob` returns frontend and backend owners plus related knowledge. Counts follow configured active-source exclusions and differ from the earlier broader frontend byte-comparison scope.

Frontend clean dependency install passed. Production build passes after declaring uuid explicitly: Vite 5.4.10, 4,816 transformed modules, 33.24 seconds. Warnings remain for old Browserslist data, pdfjs eval, mixed static/dynamic imports and large bundle chunks. These are not repaired as part of folder separation. Browser behavior remains untested.

Syntax checks for edited JS/MJS and PM2 cwd evaluation pass. Backend server, cron, DB, PM2 restart, SQL repair and deployment were not run. Frontend build status is in the generated workbook/check evidence. Index path existence, exclusion and retrieval checks are recorded there too.

Rollback layout using the old/new map in `before.json`, only after checking destination conflicts and stopping relevant app processes. Restore support/config edits from Git/source history as appropriate; preserve local changes and environment files. Do not automatically rerun any SQL repair script. Git recognizes tracked moves once reviewed/staged; no commit or branch reset was performed.

heading: Generic domain and scheduling packages — 19 October 2026
text:
# Generic domain and scheduling packages — 19 October 2026

## Architecture and provenance

Two additive, local packages were created at `1.Frontend/packages/domain-kit` and `scheduling-kit`, both version `0.1.0-cineva.1`. These are new Cineva implementations, not a claim that these versions exist upstream. HOTS in `D:/Kantor` was not modified. The owning Kantor project can review and adopt them additively while retaining existing defaults/features.

Both packages expose pure TypeScript through source exports for TypeScript/bundler consumers. They have no React, SQL, HTTP, storage, vendor labels or runtime logging dependency. They are not precompiled CommonJS packages. Frontend dependencies use the single `1.Frontend/package-lock.json` workspace.

Generic behavior is supplied through collection/field mappings, callback policies, manifests, resource capacities, intervals and injected clocks. Authorization, tenant scoping, timezone conversion, EAV meanings, translation, persistence and transaction boundaries belong to host adapters.

## Capability and adoption

| Capability | Package API | Cineva adoption / boundary |
|---|---|---|
| Object relations | `validateRelations` | Offline document users/campaigns/batches/tickets/assignments, including campaign-scoped batches |
| Cross-object rules | `createRules`, `assertRules` | Source paid amount plus simulation payments cannot exceed fee |
| Typed attributes | `validateAttribute` | Integer/money and actual date-only validation; vendor supplies required/minimum rules |
| Commands | `createCommandRegistry` | Offline `document.update`; full validation before local persistence, stale-render revision rejection |
| AI proposals | `createAIGateway` | Tested JSON allowlist gateway; not connected to a local LLM or exposed as a new API |
| Events/outbox | `createEventBus`, `executeTransactionalCommand`, `drainOutbox` | Contract tests with an in-memory transaction adapter; no deployed durable outbox |
| Module/configuration | `createModuleRegistry`, `mergeConfiguration` | Exact-version dependency and capability snapshots tested; host migration/deployment not implemented |
| Read models | `createProjectionRegistry`, `projectReadModel` | Authorization, redaction and detached output tested; no new server endpoint |
| Scheduling | `checkAvailability`, `intervalsOverlap` | Cineva job crew/gear conflicts use a capacity-one vendor adapter |
| Hotel date-only stay | `stayInterval` | Synthetic reusable example; date ordinals in days, not meeting timestamps in milliseconds |

## Consumer locations

- `1.Frontend/HOTS/src/features/cineva-offline/domainAdapter.ts`: field and relation configuration plus cash rule.
- `cineva-offline/validation.ts`: document shape, EAV and string-ID rules remain in the vendor.
- `cineva-offline/commands.ts`: explicit local demo edit context and document reducer; valid replacement JSON import remains supported.

heading: Consumer locations
text:
- `cineva-offline/OfflineDemo.tsx`: commands run before store writes; in-memory revision catches stale callbacks. This is not server authentication or cross-tab concurrency control.
- `cineva-shared/scheduling.ts`: maps named crew/gear to capacity one and preserves existing first-conflict messages, archive and update-exclusion behavior. Done but unarchived jobs retain their prior occupancy. Invalid legacy dates are skipped as before; requested invalid intervals fail closed.
- `cineva-shared/model.ts`: existing draft validation delegates resource overlap policy to the adapter.

Scheduling uses half-open intervals `[start,end)`; adjacent bookings are allowed. The engine checks supplied snapshots only. There is no authoritative reservation, lock, durable idempotency or concurrency guarantee. Future server adoption must load/recheck and commit all allocations under a real transaction with rollback. Event dispatch occurs after commit and is at least once; consumers need durable deduplication.

The offline source document/EAV contract is unchanged. A dangling batch campaign is now rejected even if no assignment points to that batch. Payment source nulls and ambiguous source dates remain unresolved; no new source values are inferred.

## Verification and remaining work

Run `npm.cmd run test:generic-packages`: package contracts plus synthetic Cineva consumer tests, strict ES2020 package typecheck, and per-source-file 1,000-line ceiling. Evidence is written under `3.Knowledge/reports/generic_packages_2026_10_19`. Existing product, booking and portable-demo browser suites verify actual consumer flows with synthetic data only. They do not use the reference workbooks or database.

Verified after adoption: 44 package/consumer tests, 7 existing offline document tests, 9 product domain tests; browser suites passed 19 HQ/Creator, 9 workflow/booking and 10 offline scenarios. Package strict typecheck has zero diagnostics; touched Cineva feature diagnostics and lint errors are zero. The full application still has 101 existing TypeScript diagnostics, so the whole legacy application is not claimed type-clean. Production build passed with existing bundle/dependency warnings. All new package source files are below 1,000 lines (largest 85). The local preview was started at `http://127.0.0.1:48175/hots/cineva-preview.html` for browser verification.

Report: `3.Knowledge/reports/generic_packages_2026_10_19/Cineva_Reusable_Packages_Report.xlsx`. The existing client HTML and ZIP were rebuilt from the unchanged JSON seed; source reference workbooks were not written.

The generic contracts are an initial local release. Still pending: real server authorization/tenant adapters, physical-schema-backed persistence, durable outbox/idempotency, booking lifecycle and recurrence policies, actual LLM provider, upstream Kantor review/release. The broader reusable-module backlog (quote, finance, import, QC and other application capabilities) remains staged; these packages do not claim all of it is complete.

No unused source file was removed. Existing functions were retained as vendor-facing adapters rather than maintaining a duplicate obsolete engine. The client demo HTML/ZIP is rebuilt from its existing authorized JSON seed; tests remain synthetic.

heading: HOTS dan Cineva: fondasi, kandidat upstream, dan batas kesiapan
text:
# HOTS dan Cineva: fondasi, kandidat upstream, dan batas kesiapan

Pemeriksaan source/dokumentasi terbatas 19 Oktober 2026. Tidak mengubah HOTS Kantor atau Cineva runtime/backend/DB. HOTS dapat menjadi fondasi Cineva melalui engine ticket/EAV, form, workflow, trigger, document/CMS dan shared UI. Ini tidak membuktikan seluruh fitur Cineva sudah tersedia sebagai paket atau berjalan end-to-end di server.

## Koreksi catatan historis

Catatan `hots_reference_followups_2026_10_14.md` adalah snapshot historis. Pemeriksaan sekarang menemukan HOTS Kantor table-engine 0.2.1 dengan Escape cancel guard, dynamic-form 0.1.1 dengan allowedFieldTypes konsisten, serta engine-client 0.2.1 dengan kontrak trigger diperbaiki. Jangan mengirim ulang ketiganya sebagai bug belum diperbaiki tanpa reproduksi baru. DynamicForm.tsx reference masih memakai label `hdf-${name}`; dukungan ID form unik pada Cineva tetap kandidat port additive, bukan klaim bug semua consumer.

## Pemisahan kemampuan

| Kemampuan Cineva | Penempatan yang disarankan | Status bukti |
|---|---|---|
| ID unik beberapa form dan table hooks terpisah | Paket form/table bersama, setelah membandingkan API dan tes | Implementasi lokal Cineva; sebagian bug lama sudah diperbaiki upstream |
| HTML demo mandiri + JSON + storage adapter | Paket demo/export terpisah yang opsional | Demo lokal diuji file URL; bukan pengganti persistence server |
| Quote version, snapshot acceptance, stale revision | Modul umum opsional dengan policy vendor | Cineva frontend dummy; implementasi server belum diverifikasi |
| Milestone/calendar/resource overlap/explicit booking | Modul scheduling opsional dengan resource adapter | Aturan lokal ada; transaksi/concurrency server belum terbukti |
| Draft/revisi/QC/output/posting | Preset konfigurasi workflow dan assignment | Domain/policy tetap Cineva, mesin reusable tidak diganti |
| Cash vs barter, partial payment, payout history | Modul financial metadata/ledger opsional | Bukan core accounting engine; belum integrasi bank/DB |
| Source Excel mapping, raw values/provenance, review konflik | Import adapter + validasi/preview umum | Bridge lokal dan export; bukan importer produksi atau DDL |
| Brand, niche, Simply Juun, KPI creator dan tiga jenis jasa | Program/preset Cineva | Tidak menjadi default HOTS lintas vendor |

Engine HOTS tidak perlu mengetahui Melin, Lifestyle atau Simply Juun. Ia memerlukan kontrak umum untuk field, relasi, workflow, versioning dan extension hooks. Cineva menentukan nama field/label, state policy, domain rules serta presentation brown/gold/white. Page-engine HOTS masih mendokumentasikan renderer belum diekstrak; keberadaan paket bukan bukti renderer siap.

## Gap yang tetap harus dibuktikan

Multi-tenant authorization server dan pembatasan data HQ/Creator; persistensi serta schema fisik; transaction/rollback dan idempotency untuk mutasi; server guard stale/concurrent changes; upload/deliverable storage; payment/subscription provider; local LLM dan otorisasi aksi; scheduler/reminder delivery; integrasi runtime auth/SSE/CMS/ticket/assignment. Preview/dummy/localStorage tidak membuktikan semuanya selesai. Kemampuan IAM yang sudah ada tidak otomatis membuktikan isolasi SaaS per workspace.

Prioritas upstream: (1) rebase/audit local forks terhadap reference terbaru, (2) port fix ID form unik dan export demo sebagai capability opt-in, (3) stabilkan kontrak versioning/assignment/scheduling adapters, (4) baru implementasi server Cineva menggunakan schema terverifikasi dan tes dummy. Semua upstream additive, default/fitur lama dipertahankan; pelaksanaan di Kantor oleh project pemiliknya.

Sumber yang diperiksa: Kantor `3.Knowledge/KNOWLEDGE_GRAPH.md`, package metadata/changelog/source table-engine/dynamic-form/engine-client dan page-engine README; Cineva knowledge registry, Campaign Operations, maturity dan demo offline. Ini audit source terbatas, bukan audit menyeluruh seluruh modul Kantor atau pengujian production. Tidak ada E2E baru pada tugas dokumentasi ini.

heading: HOTS Kantor follow-ups — notes only
text:
# HOTS Kantor follow-ups — notes only

Date: 2026-10-14. These notes belong to Cineva. The Office project owner may review them later; this task never edits HOTS Kantor.

Authoritative machine-readable list: `3.Knowledge/scripts/package_upgrade_2026_10_14/gaps.json`, reference section. Evidence is current source, copied package metadata and mock browser reproduction; live deployment impact is not verified.

## Priority findings

1. **Escape cancellation saves the draft (P0):** table-engine EditableCell sets state then immediately blurs, causing the prior closure to save. Reproduced; fixed only in the Cineva 0.2.0-cineva.1 fork with a skip-blur ref. Add a keyboard cancellation regression check in the Office package.
2. **Builder inspector ignores allowedFieldTypes (P1):** creation catalog is restricted but the field-type editor enumerates all registry entries. Cineva constrains its registry. Add an additive consistent allowed-type policy in the reference builder.
3. **Trigger client types/filter names drift (P1):** backend reads `function_type`/`is_active`, package's list type exposes `type`; categories return `{category,count}` objects but are typed `string[]`. Cineva keeps explicit compatibility mapping. Correct public types/aliases without breaking old callers.
4. **UI source-package peer resolution (P1):** optional-peer components are exported from the barrel and can fail resolution when the peer exists only under the host. Document host/workspace resolution and provide public component subpaths. Cineva adds subpaths and configures Vite/TypeScript host resolution. The preset's plugin dependency also requires a real shared dependency root.
5. **Missing typed engine clients (P1):** ticket/assignment/document/report-table calls still lack a reusable client surface; package README explicitly lists this gap. Derive clients from actual routes/envelopes rather than copying inline app calls.
6. **Domain inspector hooks (P1):** structured row groups, special CMS/HTML/diagram elements and widget-specific inspectors still need app add-ons. Optional hooks/registries would improve reuse while keeping app store/API out of packages.
7. **Auth contract/documentation conflict (P0):** HOTS authToken comment says memory-only while implementation writes localStorage; app-core drops Bearer headers and expects cookies. Coordinate backend, MFE sharing and docs before a universal transport switch.
8. **HOTS adoption remains partial (P1):** generic UI, table/API/form paths still have app-local implementations even though reusable packages exist. Plan gradual adoption with compatibility and runtime acceptance; package presence is not adoption.
9. **Registry/readme version drift (P2):** app-core and engine-client README versions/status differ from package.json. Generate or validate compatibility/version/status tables against source imports and metadata.
10. **page-engine/app-template readiness (P2):** responsive/CSS helpers do not constitute a complete page renderer; app-template and commerce-kit remain candidates. Do not treat them as completed reusable surfaces.

## Ownership and validation

### Additional Cineva finding, 18 October 2026

Multiple flat dynamic forms on one page can share `hdf-deadline` / `hdf-title` DOM IDs. Browser E2E reproduced a label pointing to a hidden field in another form. Cineva local dynamic-form 0.1.0-cineva.2 adds an opt-in `inputId` for custom renderer labels and its HotsForm uses a unique per-form prefix; schema decoration is memoized to preserve entered values. Office may evaluate additive per-form ID support across its own built-in/custom renderers, row groups and accessibility tests. This is a note only: no Office source was inspected or changed for this finding, and impact there is unverified.

Cineva owns its adapters/forks and acceptance against its own backend. The Office project owns any future change to HOTS/reference packages. Reproduce failures in an isolated test fixture before applying an Office patch. No database SQL should be generated from conceptual schema docs; physical schema and transaction prerequisites remain required for backend adoption.

heading: Rencana pemenuhan requirement Cineva A/B dari voice note
text:
# Rencana pemenuhan requirement Cineva A/B dari voice note

Status awal: rencana 18 Oktober 2026. Update: [Paket 1–4 sudah diimplementasikan dan diuji pada batas frontend dummy](cineva_service_flow_2026_10_18.md); Paket 5 masih ditunda. Bagian di bawah mempertahankan rencana/acceptance awal sebagai konteks, bukan klaim backend live.
Sumber: [voice note dan requirement VN01–VN08](voice_requirements_2026_10_18.md), [arah produk sebelumnya](cineva_dual_product_direction_2026_10_18.md), serta [preview A/B existing](dual_product_preview_2026_10_18.md).

## Hasil yang dituju

App A mengelola kebutuhan production house: client/brand, campaign, production, content shoot, brief, estimasi dan penanganan permintaan jasa. App B mempertahankan personal job tracker dan menambahkan pintu permintaan jasa fotografer/videografer kepada Cineva. Assistant/CS dapat melibatkan AI dan manusia. Label A/B dan desain jalur permintaan adalah interpretasi atas arsitektur produk sebelumnya; detail yang belum pasti pada ASR tidak dijadikan aturan bisnis baru.

Alur sasaran: pilih layanan → isi brief → kirim permintaan → review HQ/CS → estimasi/penawaran → persetujuan → project HOTS → penjadwalan → pelaksanaan → deliverable → pembayaran/arsip. Status inquiry, quote, pekerjaan dan pembayaran terpisah; mengirim permintaan bukan otomatis mengonfirmasi booking.

## Batas dan dampak arsitektur

- HOTS `D:/Kantor` hanya referensi, tidak disentuh. Perubahan vendor di Cineva, memakai snapshot paket lokal dan provenance fork.
- Pertahankan UI coklat/emas/putih dan workflow marketplace legacy. Reuse dynamic-form, ui-kit, table-engine dan app-core. Jangan membuat engine form/ticket/auth/workflow kedua.
- Pisahkan domain ke modul service catalog, inquiry, quoting dan support; komponen tampilan hanya mengomposisi modul. Target 150–350 baris per komponen/hook bila wajar, batas keras 1.000 baris per file baru/diubah. Jangan menekan baris dengan memadatkan kode.
- Tahap 1–4 hanya frontend/repository dummy. Tidak menjalankan backend bisnis, SQL, migrasi, provider pembayaran, pesan eksternal atau database asli.
- Shape domain frontend bukan DDL. Integrasi nyata tetap mengikuti `cstm_col`, `lbl_col`, `value`, physical schema dan transaction + commit + rollback.
- Request lintas workspace harus berbagi field secara eksplisit ke penerima yang dituju; bukan membuka seluruh data Creator kepada HQ atau semua HQ kepada Creator. Simulasi ini tidak membuktikan tenant authorization.

## Paket 1 — Katalog, brief dan estimator dalam satu pekerjaan

Requirement: VN01, VN02, VN04, VN06. Dependensi: fondasi preview existing.

Bangun katalog terkonfigurasi untuk Campaign, Production, Content Shoot. Graduation, birthday, iklan, fotografer/videografer menjadi contoh layanan/opsi dalam katalog; pemetaan finalnya dapat diedit, bukan dikunci sebagai asumsi dari audio. Setiap jenis memiliki field brief yang relevan: brand/PIC, tujuan, deliverable, lokasi, jadwal/durasi, kebutuhan kru/jasa dan budget indikatif. Campaign dapat membawa periode dan lingkup kerja, bukan dipaksa menjadi satu sesi shoot.

Reuse `HotsForm` dan registry dynamic-form. Pisahkan editor brief dari job editor agar tidak memuat semua variasi ke satu file. Estimator memakai rate card dummy yang terlihat dan dapat dikonfigurasi: rincian item, jumlah, satuan, subtotal, total serta versi tarif. Simpan snapshot penawaran; perubahan rate card tidak diam-diam mengubah quote lama. Angka adalah simulasi, belum harga resmi. Jangan memasukkan formula bisnis ke komponen JSX.

Lokasi: `1.Frontend/HOTS/src/features/cineva-services/` untuk `catalog.ts`, `briefSchemas.ts`, `pricing.ts`, `ServicePicker.tsx`, `ServiceBriefForm.tsx`, `QuoteBreakdown.tsx`; adapter/komposisi pada `cineva-hq/EstimatorView.tsx`, `cineva-shared/JobEditor.tsx`, `HotsForm.tsx`. Nama file adalah target rencana, bukan file yang sudah ada.

heading: Paket 1 — Katalog, brief dan estimator dalam satu pekerjaan
text:
Acceptance dummy: masing-masing tiga layanan menampilkan dan memvalidasi brief yang benar; berganti layanan mempertahankan field bersama tanpa membawa field tidak relevan; item/total quote benar; angka invalid ditolak; rate card baru tidak mengubah snapshot lama; membuat job manual existing tetap berjalan.

## Paket 2 — Permintaan Creator/client, queue HQ dan konversi project

Requirement: VN02, VN06, VN07. Dependensi: Paket 1.

Tambahkan menu layanan pada B, draft brief, pengiriman request dan pelacakan status. A mempunyai queue inquiry, detail brief, assignment PIC dummy, penyusunan/revisi quote dan keputusan accept/reject. Setelah persetujuan yang sesuai, konversikan inquiry sekali menjadi project melalui adapter yang sama dengan create job existing. Pada dummy gunakan repository; saat live gunakan engine ticket existing, bukan implementasi ticket baru.

Usulan state inquiry: Draft → Submitted → Reviewing → Quoted → Accepted/Rejected/Cancelled. Nama/transisi final perlu dikonfigurasi; bukan state yang disebut lengkap oleh pembicara. Project dan pembayaran tetap state terpisah. Persetujuan quote tidak menjamin resource tersedia; cek konflik lagi saat alokasi/konfirmasi. Bedakan budget permintaan, quote penawaran dan fee project yang disetujui.

Gunakan source request ID, owner workspace dan destination workspace pada view model. Broker dummy hanya mengirim data brief yang dipilih dan balasan yang relevan; jangan membuat seluruh storage A/B dapat dibaca satu sama lain. Percobaan ulang memakai identity request yang sama untuk mencegah duplicate project. Perubahan status hanya terjadi setelah save berhasil. Pertahankan arsip/data dummy lama dengan migrasi storage versi atau fallback yang teruji.

Lokasi target: `cineva-inquiries/{types.ts,transitions.ts,repository.ts,dummyRepository.ts,InquiryEditor.tsx,InquiryDetail.tsx}`, `creator-space/ServiceRequestsView.tsx`, `cineva-hq/InquiryInbox.tsx`; update komposisi `cineva-shared/CinevaProgram.tsx`, `navigation.ts`, `WorkspaceContext.tsx` bila dibutuhkan, tanpa memperbesar tanggung jawabnya.

Acceptance dummy: request B masuk hanya ke HQ tujuan; Creator lain tidak melihatnya; HQ tidak melihat finance/job pribadi yang tidak dibagikan; reload mempertahankan request dan balasan; double submit/convert tidak membuat project ganda; cancel/reject tidak membuat project; gagal save tidak mengubah state; inquiry menjadi project tanpa kehilangan brief; konflik resource ditolak.

## Paket 3 — CS manusia dan assistant melalui adapter

Requirement: VN03. Dependensi: Paket 2 dan identitas request/workspace dummy.

Sediakan percakapan terkait inquiry/project, daftar percakapan HQ, assignment agen dummy, jawaban manusia dan handover AI → manusia. Pengguna dapat memilih bantuan manusia. Konteks brief dan riwayat tetap ada saat handover; assistant tidak terus membalas seolah agen manusia. Status usulan: AI handling, waiting for agent, human handling, resolved. Return-to-AI harus tindakan eksplisit.

Definisikan provider interface terpisah dari UI. Tahap ini menggunakan deterministic fake AI untuk memberi pertanyaan pengumpulan brief dan menyarankan draft; tandai simulasi. Provider lokal nyata baru pada Paket 5. Output AI adalah usulan yang divalidasi; tidak menentukan tenant, role, harga resmi, persetujuan atau status sendiri. Respons terlambat setelah handover harus diabaikan; failure provider tidak mengirim pesan sukses palsu atau mengubah inquiry.

Lokasi target: `cineva-support/{types.ts,repository.ts,provider.ts,dummyProvider.ts,handover.ts,ConversationPanel.tsx,ConversationList.tsx}`, `cineva-hq/SupportInbox.tsx`; pecah assistant dari `creator-space/CreatorViews.tsx` menjadi view kecil yang mengomposisi adapter. Pertahankan fungsi create-job assistant existing sebagai aksi terpisah yang kompatibel.

Acceptance dummy: percakapan sesuai inquiry/workspace; request agent membawa konteks; agen dapat membalas dan menyelesaikan; AI tidak membalas sesudah handover; respons tertunda/retry tidak menggandakan pesan; failure/reload/cancel aman; tidak ada request ke LLM/WhatsApp/email eksternal.

## Paket 4 — Integrasi A/B dan regresi menyeluruh

heading: Paket 4 — Integrasi A/B dan regresi menyeluruh
text:
Dependensi: Paket 1–3; bukan alasan menunda tes pada setiap paket.

Uji journey lengkap B memilih jasa → HQ mereview → CS AI/manusia → quote → diterima → project → jadwal → deliverable → pencatatan pembayaran dummy → arsip. Uji jalur langsung client dari A juga, sehingga layanan tidak mengharuskan semua client mempunyai akun Creator.

E2E tiap paket mencakup desktop/mobile, keyboard/focus, brown/gold/white theme, empty/error/loading, save failure dan reload. Gunakan isolated browser context dan dua Creator serta dua HQ sintetis untuk membuktikan perilaku sharing dummy sesuai target. Browser network guard menolak backend/external calls. Jangan menyebutnya bukti keamanan tenant server.

Regresi: existing package contracts, table/browser component tests, product domain/E2E, vendor theme checks dan production build. Tambahkan guard 1.000 baris untuk modul fitur yang disentuh, bukan hanya table-engine; lint serta TypeScript bandingkan diagnostics terhadap baseline, laporkan debt yang masih ada. Jangan mengubah baseline test agar menutupi failure. Update knowledge, package provenance jika ada fork change, dan Excel evidence setelah setiap paket.

Lokasi test baru: `3.Knowledge/scripts/cineva_service_flow_2026_10_18/`; gunakan fixture/repository dummy. Hasil di `3.Knowledge/reports/`. E2E dan hasil kelulusan pada dokumen ini seluruhnya masih rencana.

## Paket 5 — Integrasi nyata, ditunda sesuai instruksi database

Mulai hanya setelah user membuka kembali scope DB dan tersedia physical schema, membership/tenant ownership, role CS, engine ticket service contract, auth dan konfigurasi provider. Belum ada SQL/Prisma yang dibuat.

Urutan: backend tenancy/authorization dan kontrak → service catalog/inquiry/quote/support domain adapters → transaction-bound ticket conversion dan idempotency → local LLM provider dengan timeout/structured output validation → integrasi CMS/deliverable → dummy DB E2E. LLM dipanggil sebelum transaction write yang singkat; revalidasi otorisasi dan data sebelum commit. SSE/log business events mengikuti parser existing dan dipublikasikan setelah commit. Uji rollback dan retry.

Module backend target di `2.Backend/Integrated-API/programs/cineva/` dan router vendor existing setelah mount/auth ditelusuri. Ini rancangan lokasi, bukan izin membuat service paralel tanpa audit source. Test DB memakai database dummy saja, tidak menjalankan repair/cron atau menyentuh database Kantor.

Subscription/payment gateway, tarif komersial, reminder provider dan SLA CS dicatat sebagai backlog dari arahan sebelumnya; tidak otomatis masuk Paket 1–3 karena tidak dirinci dalam voice note. Jangan menghapus kebutuhan sebelumnya, tetapi beri milestone/acceptance terpisah saat scope siap.

## Definition of done

Setiap paket menghasilkan fitur/modul yang selesai, regresi dan E2E dummy lulus, tidak ada file baru/diubah melebihi 1.000 baris, dokumentasi dan Excel evidence diperbarui, dan boundary original HOTS/DB tetap dipatuhi. Integrasi nyata hanya dinyatakan selesai setelah backend/dummy DB tests, bukan karena preview berfungsi. Rencana ini tidak mengklaim harga final, verifikasi manual seluruh istilah ASR, atau kesiapan produksi.

heading: Crosscheck Excel live lokal
text:
# Crosscheck Excel live lokal

Pengguna secara eksplisit meminta data tidak disamarkan dan live dari Excel pada 18 Oktober 2026. Keputusan ini menggantikan preview snapshot tersamarkan pada `account_reference_2026_10_18.md`. Tiga pemilihan semula dipertahankan dari `reports/account_reference_2026_10_18/selection.json`, bukan diacak ulang. Nama dan isi sel asli boleh ditampilkan di browser lokal untuk crosscheck; tidak diekspor ke report, knowledge, fixture tes atau bundle source.

## Batas arsitektur

- `scripts/live_reference_2026_10_18/server.py` adalah bridge lokal hanya baca pada **127.0.0.1:48176**. Endpoint tetap `/accounts`, allowlist dua nama workbook, tidak menerima parameter path/file dan tidak memiliki write endpoint. Host serta Origin dibatasi untuk preview lokal. Tidak menghubungkan database, engine transaksi, upload atau HOTS kantor.
- Vite dev/preview proxy `/hots/reference-excel/accounts` ke bridge; ini konfigurasi preview lokal, bukan endpoint backend production yang dideploy. Jalankan preview dengan host 127.0.0.1. Tidak menjadikan file workbook endpoint download publik.
- Setiap request membaca byte file terbaru lalu membuka formula dan cached values dari byte yang sama. Tidak memakai output snapshot lama, tidak menulis workbook. UI membaca saat dibuka, setiap 30 detik dan lewat tombol **Muat ulang dari Excel**. Perubahan Excel perlu disimpan lebih dahulu. Bridge harus tetap berjalan; restart command menggunakan bundled Python.
- `ReferenceAccounts.tsx` memakai Card/Badge/Button dan theme vendor existing. `liveSource.ts` menyediakan fetch adapter no-store/omit credentials. Tidak menyimpan respons di localStorage, aplikasi dummy, data ledger atau DB. Respons no-store, tanpa log nilai pribadi.
- Roster dan tabel lanjutan dicocokkan dengan nama unik dalam sheet. Nama duplikat ditandai dan tidak digabung. Sheet/baris/hash saat baca ditampilkan. Pemilihan mengacu koordinat roster semula: jika struktur/baris berubah, perlu review pemilihan; bukan identity reconciliation engine.

## Nilai sumber dan maknanya

Roster menampilkan semua kolom berheader termasuk nama, sosial, telepon, alamat, produk dan progress sumber sesuai izin pengguna. Tabel lanjutan menampilkan progress/engagement asli. Brief/budget/timeline memuat isi S:U di bagian overview terkait. Setiap field mempunyai label, koordinat, tipe, number format dan formula jika ada.

Sel null/empty ditandai **Kosong di Excel**, bukan generik belum tersedia. Angka 0 dipertahankan. Teks kategori pada FOLLOWERS tidak diubah menjadi null/0. URL ditampilkan utuh sebagai teks, tanpa membuka atau mengambil konten link. Error cache seperti `#DIV/0!` terlihat bersama rumusnya. Native Excel recalculation tidak dilakukan; nilai formula bergantung pada cache hasil simpan Excel. Currency/budget campaign tidak dianggap fee pribadi dan STATUS PAYMENT tidak otomatis menjadi paid_amount.

### Klarifikasi pengguna: followers dan niche

Pengguna menegaskan FOLLOWERS adalah jumlah pengikut Instagram; jawaban **Lifestyle** harus masuk niche/kategori konten. `profileMapping.ts` memisahkan angka followers valid (integer non-negatif, termasuk 0 dan string angka/grouped ribuan) dari teks niche. FOLLOWERS TIKTOK tidak diambil sebagai jumlah Instagram. `ReferenceSummary.tsx` menampilkan **Followers Instagram** hanya numerik; jika belum ada angka, ditulis **Jumlah belum tercatat**. **Niche / kategori konten** menampilkan Lifestyle sebagai tag dengan koordinat sumber.

Header sumber yang keliru tetap bisa diperiksa dalam detail: `Niche konten (header Excel: FOLLOWERS)` disertai nilai, koordinat dan format aslinya. Excel tidak diedit. Mapping dilakukan pada adapter tampilan; bukan DB migration atau perubahan engine. Satu E2E tambahan memakai Lifestyle sintetis untuk membuktikan kategori tidak tampil sebagai jumlah pengikut; total suite live sekarang **6 E2E**.

Sebelumnya banyak placeholder timbul dari penyederhanaan adapter: identitas disamarkan, string selain whitelist diganti catatan generik, follower kategori menjadi null, dan cash pribadi tidak memiliki sumber nominal. Preview live menghilangkan penyederhanaan itu untuk pemeriksaan sumber; data yang benar-benar kosong tetap kosong.

## Pengujian dan operasi

Empat unit test Python memakai workbook objects sintetis/mocked: raw link/category/error/formula, zero versus blank, duplicate-name ambiguity dan path allowlist; tidak membaca workbook asli. Lima browser E2E memakai endpoint sintetis untuk nama/raw/formula, tiga deep-link, refresh data baru, failure/recovery dan tanpa localStorage/external request. Data nyata hanya dibaca runtime untuk crosscheck yang diizinkan, bukan fixture tes.

heading: E2E lokal nyata: HOTS, Overseas, Integrated-API
text:
# E2E lokal nyata: HOTS, Overseas, Integrated-API

21 Oktober 2026, Asia/Jakarta. User supplied running URLs and authorized dummy login for Yosua, then Marcel. Browser interactions used CUA against actual pages; separate real HTTP API probes used credentials only in memory. No fixture/API interception, Kantor source edit, restart, deployment or grant change. Normal authentication changes login/session metadata; this is not a database-write-free run. No ticket create/edit/approve/payment, file export, or business mutation was performed.

Targets: HOTS http://localhost:8080/hots/, Overseas http://localhost:8084/overseas/, PAR remote 8085, backend http://localhost:9999. Origins confirmed from current frontend config. Kantor source layout has evolved to app/http/registerRoutes.js and programs/hots/core/auth; older paths in prior audits must not be assumed current.

Evidence: ../reports/local_live_e2e_2026_10_21/summary.json, api.json (Yosua), api.marcel.sarsito.json, oidc-metadata.json and screenshots. API probes do not save credentials, cookies, bearer tokens, entire login payloads or PAR form data. JWT claim decoding is observational only, never signature verification or an access grant. Re-run API probes via api-probe.mjs runProbe with credentials supplied transiently; do not embed them in scripts/env/report files.

Excel: [Local Live E2E](../reports/local_live_e2e_2026_10_21/outputs/Local_Live_E2E.xlsx), rendered and visually inspected. Summary contains 12 PASS, 2 FAIL (two scenarios of one dashboard defect), 3 GAP and 2 NOT_TESTED. The final foreign-ticket browser check was repeated after reauthentication: denial remained visible without the session-expired overlay. Overseas was logged out and all agent-created test tabs were closed; user app servers were left running.

## Verified behavior

- Yosua (user 1004, role 4) logs into HOTS; My Tickets shows 130. Overseas IndoUSA portal/PAR loads real data (47). Login to IndoCanada succeeds and All PAR shows 0.
- Actual tokens contain login_company_id=2/country=704 for IndoUSA, and company=3/country=716 for Canada. Keep-login preserves both. Default PAR list follows signed login context. Admin explicit company override remains possible and is not reported as a vulnerability.
- Marcel (user 1033, role 2) is denied IndoUSA login with the business message 'bukan negara area akun tersebut', but is allowed IndoCanada. No role/grant was changed to make the tests pass.
- Marcel's Canada token returns an empty PAR list for both its own company and manipulated company_id=2. Reading the observed USA ticket form-data endpoint returns 403, and the browser shows 'You are not allowed to view this PAR ticket'. This tests the selected ticket/country pair, not every resource type/company combination.
- Anonymous PAR ticket request returns 401. Overseas logout redirects to login; both same-origin Overseas tabs synchronize the logout. HOTS remained authenticated after Overseas logout/reload in the earlier controlled browser step. Subsequent independent API logins caused reauthentication prompts; these prompts are not independently attributed to the company-isolation feature.

## F01: dashboard aggregate crosses company authorization (high priority)

Same Marcel Canada token:

| Request | Response |
|---|---|
| GET /engine/par-document/tickets?company_id=2&page=1&limit=20 | HTTP 200, 0 rows |
| GET /engine/par-document/tickets/2610813000047/form-data | HTTP 403 |
| GET /engine/par-document/dashboard-summary?company_id=3 | HTTP 200, total 0 |
| GET /engine/par-document/dashboard-summary?company_id=2 | HTTP 200, total 47 |
| GET /engine/par-document/dashboard-summary | HTTP 200, total 47 |

heading: F01: dashboard aggregate crosses company authorization (high priority)
text:
Read-only MCP confirms all 47 existing service-108 tickets belong to company 2 at this snapshot. No company-3 ticket exists in that aggregate. UI shows Canada / Marcel while the dashboard shows 47 PAR. This is confirmed unauthorized aggregate visibility for the tested account; it does not establish full foreign ticket/form access, which was denied.

Cause traced in current read-only Kantor source:
- Frontend 1.Frontend/overseas_module/par/src/ParModule.tsx:226 sends date filters but no active company_id for dashboard-summary.
- Backend app/modules/par-document/parDocument.controller.js:353 passes userId and optional query company, not the same signed login scope used by ticket listing.
- Backend app/modules/par-document/parDocument.service.parts/reporting/get-par-dashboard-summary.js:16 accepts userId but builds the SQL scope from service_id and unvalidated optional companyId; the observed function does not apply actor visibility/ownership rules to the aggregate.

Architectural fix proposal, not applied here: reuse a modular PAR visibility-scope builder for list/count/dashboard, validating actor permissions and selected company on the server. The frontend must send/select its active company for UI consistency, but adding only that parameter does not prevent a caller requesting another company or omitting the filter. Include direct manipulated-request regression tests and read-only non-admin browser acceptance. Do not broaden roles or create blanket grants as a workaround.

## Remaining SaaS integration gaps

- New GET /api/tenant/v1/bootstrap returns 404 on the actual local backend. The tenant foundation implemented in Cineva has not been adopted by the running Kantor app. Successful legacy login is not proof that the new hierarchy grants or ticket-ownership overlay enforce these endpoints.
- Local OIDC discovery works: issuer http://localhost:9999/oauth, authorization/token/JWKS endpoints and S256 metadata are real JSON. HOTS .env/.env.development explicitly set VITE_SSO_ENFORCED=false; Overseas signs in via /hots_auth/login. Complete browser Code/PKCE/client delegation/global logout was not tested. Do not confuse the working local provider with the older production-process inspection.
- Overseas uses shared localStorage overseas_session and a storage listener in src/App.tsx:70-73. Two same-origin tabs follow one shared session/context; tab 2 logout routes tab 1 to login. This is a gap for independent per-tab company workspaces, not evidence of a foreign-row leak by itself.
- Company selector is a static list in overseas_base/src/data/demoData.ts, currently IndoUSA and IndoCanada. The new company hierarchy/IndoVietnam and program registry are not its data source.

## Outcome and next work

Real local integration can be tested and core login/list/detail paths work. SaaS signoff is blocked by the confirmed dashboard isolation defect and missing foundation adoption; the summary also records SSO/per-tab gaps and untested write workflows. No fixes were applied to Kantor because it remains a read-only source reference from this workspace. The next implementation should occur in the owning HOTS project with a bounded shared scope fix, followed by rerunning these actual-account scenarios. Reports/Excel and all one-off scripts stay in Cineva knowledge.

heading: Notification/SSE package extraction and adoption — 19 October 2026
text:
# Notification/SSE package extraction and adoption — 19 October 2026

## Scope and user authorization

The user explicitly extended the earlier read-only rule to permit upgrading frontend packages in **D:/Kantor/1.Frontend/packages**. This task changes only `app-core` there: additive source API, export subpaths, tests, package version/script and package-local documentation. It does not authorize changing Kantor applications, backend, database, deployments, knowledge indices or unrelated files. All audit/report/index outputs remain in Cineva. General historical read-only statements should be read with this explicit exception for this task.

## Architecture

Existing HOTS already has persistent notifications, unread/read endpoints, server SSE management, named events and frontend SSE helpers. This work packages those responsibilities through adapters rather than claiming the feature did not previously exist.

Frontend HOTS `@hots/app-core` is upgraded from 0.5.1 to **0.6.0**. New APIs: `createNotificationClient`, `subscribeNotificationEvents`; source subpaths `/notifications` and `/sse`. Existing root exports and `connectSSE`/`useSSE` options are retained. The existing upstream exact-origin HTTP credential fix remains untouched. Cineva app-core becomes **0.6.0-cineva.1**, including that HTTP fix and the same notification addon. Other upstream packages were not changed. The package-local docs describe behavior and tests; no upstream knowledge writers were run because authorization is restricted to frontend packages.

Backend Cineva adds `2.Backend/packages/notification-kit` **0.1.0-cineva.1**:

- Generic JSON SSE framing, Node writable backpressure, bounded frame queue, cleanup and explicit scoped connection hub.
- Notification inbox engine with injected identity/clock/format/authorization, transaction repository and transport ports.
- No SQL/schema assumptions or environment/database/credential imports.

`core/sse-manager.js` adopts the package writer for user events, legacy broadcast and filtered admin logs. Existing singleton methods, persistence controller, event policy and message envelopes remain. The original is archived at `3.Knowledge/_archive/notification_package_2026_10_19/sse-manager.before.js`; restore that source to roll back the writer adapter. The new generic repository engine is tested through an isolated transaction fixture; it is **not** mounted as a new production service or physical DB migration.

## Cineva frontend adoption

- `src/hooks/notificationAdapter.ts`: legacy API routes, response envelope and authentication stay in the host; generic package owns inbox request operations and response guards.
- `src/components/layout/NotificationBell.tsx`: uses the package client, preserving the existing UI and vendor theme.
- `src/hooks/useSSE.tsx`: subscribes to named notification events through the package helper, forwarding a local host signal to the bell and cleaning up listeners.

Observed defect: the bell formerly read `window.__sseConnection`, but no Cineva source assigned it. It also only replaced `onmessage`; named SSE events require named listeners. The new path no longer depends on that absent global and does not replace other subscribers. Existing legacy token-in-query auth is retained, not certified or silently replaced with an incompatible cookie/ticket contract.

## Boundaries

heading: Boundaries
text:
The scoped generic hub uses an explicit tenant/user tuple, with authorization supplied by the host. Dummy tests prove the configured adapter isolates scopes; they do not prove existing HOTS/Cineva production tenant isolation. The legacy singleton still targets its existing user IDs and is not converted into SaaS multi-tenancy here.

`write() === false` means a frame was accepted into the Node buffer. Subsequent frames wait for drain without closing or duplicating that frame. Queue overflow closes a slow consumer. Accepted frames are not confirmed browser delivery. Hosts must bound payload byte size, coordinate heartbeats, authenticate stream connections, and provide process-shared pub/sub for multiple workers if required. Durable replay/outbox/retry after process failure is pending.

The repository port requires transaction/commit/rollback semantics and full scoped lookups. No real DB adapter is added; the user deferred database work. Existing legacy DB writes and auth routes are not audited as transaction-safe by this change.

## Verification

- 14 backend/legacy contract tests, plus 3 frontend tests against each of the Kantor and Cineva package sources: 20 test executions.
- Six browser E2E scenarios use the real Cineva bell, actual loopback HTTP/SSE and a synthetic in-memory transaction repository: inbox/badge, mark-read/reload, named event update, foreign tenant isolation, failed-write/retry, mobile history.
- New frontend API strict TypeScript: zero diagnostics in both source locations. Cineva full-app baseline remains 101 diagnostics, with none newly introduced by this task; production build passed.
- Existing package regressions: 17 passed; product domain regressions: 9 passed. No real user/workbook/DB fixtures.
- New package source files and modified source remain below 1,000 lines.

Commands: `npm.cmd run test:notifications`, `npm.cmd run test:notifications:e2e`; upstream package supports `npm.cmd --prefix D:/Kantor/1.Frontend/packages/app-core run test:notifications` under Node 24+ (native TypeScript test support).

Evidence: `3.Knowledge/reports/notification_package_2026_10_19/{checks.json,e2e-results.json,backend-tests.txt,kantor-client-tests.txt,cineva-client-tests.txt}` and Excel report. Future Kantor backend extraction/adoption remains owned by that project.

# Online Order Kantor: Flavour 2 tersangkut

## Implementasi setelah persetujuan pengguna

Pengguna menyetujui perbaikan dengan jawaban "ya" setelah pembahasan reset Flavour 2 di Kantor. Pengecualian sesi ini terbatas pada source komponen E-Order tersebut dan validasi build lokal. Dokumentasi/laporan/script tetap disimpan di Cineva. Tidak deploy atau menulis database/CMS.

- Handler membandingkan SKU lintas tipe dengan String. Bila slot awal mengambil SKU slot berikutnya, slot yang bentrok dan slot dependen sesudahnya direset ke sku "-1", qty "0", tolling/pallet nol dan MOQ/kapasitas kosong.
- Filter per-slot tetap menolak SKU milik slot sebelumnya. Penghapusan filter includes global mempertahankan opsi aktif serta memungkinkan Flavour 1 mengambil SKU Flavour 2, yang kini dibersihkan oleh handler.
- Reset existing pada jalur pallet sekarang menggunakan helper yang sama, mengganti SKU 0 menjadi "-1" dengan metadata kosong.
- ContainerRuleEngine dan aturan kapasitas/MOQ/rasio tidak diubah. Form biasa dan Container Groups memakai editor yang sama.
- Reproduksi sebelum patch gagal: Flavour 2 masih SKU numeric 200, expected "-1". Setelah patch, pemeriksaan handler aktual lulus untuk bentrok lintas tipe, reset slot dependen/metadata, pilihan berbeda, clear manual dan pallet. Script: ../scripts/check_online_order_flavour_reset_2026_10_22.cjs.
- Sembilan tes containerGroups existing lulus. Build Vite E-Order lulus (1840 modules, 21.29 detik) dengan warning dependency pdfjs eval dan ukuran bundle. Browser authenticated, backend submit, data DB dan production belum diverifikasi.

Bagian audit di bawah adalah bukti kondisi sebelum perbaikan.

## Klarifikasi lanjutan

Pengguna menegaskan filter Flavour 2 agar tidak memilih Flavour 1 adalah fitur yang disengaja. Jangan menghapus aturan anti-duplikat.

Source non-bulk: saat Flavour 1 berubah pada pallet === 0, baris 533-536 hanya mereset quantity slot berikutnya, tidak SKU. Jika perubahan ke SKU yang sama berhasil masuk, kedua SKU dapat tetap sama dalam state, dengan quantity slot kedua nol. Filter baris 731-732 menyembunyikan opsi yang sama dari Flavour 2, tetapi tidak mengubah state menjadi -1. Apakah Flavour 1 bisa memilih SKU Flavour 2 melalui UI juga bergantung pemeriksaan includes yang sensitif tipe pada baris 751.

Pada jalur pallet selain numeric 0, baris 551 memanggil updateFlavour(nextFlavour, 0, "-1", ...), sehingga SKU berikutnya menjadi numeric 0, bukan string -1. Ini berbeda dari placeholder.

Usulan sesuai pertanyaan pengguna: jika SKU Flavour 1 yang baru sama dengan Flavour 2, kosongkan slot Flavour 2 secara eksplisit dengan sku string -1 dan quantity nol, beserta metadata dependen. Pertahankan filter anti-duplikat. Belum implementasi atau reproduksi runtime.

Tanggal: 22 Oktober 2026. Audit source read-only Kantor. Tidak mengubah aplikasi/database.

Pengguna melaporkan Flavour 2 bisa dikosongkan setelah memilih flavour lain, kemudian Choose Flavour. Lokasi kasus adalah Online Order Kantor, bukan Cineva.

Source: D:/Kantor/1.Frontend/E-Order/src/features/orders/components/AddMoreContainer/FlavourNonBulk_Component.jsx.

heading: Klarifikasi lanjutan
text:
- Baris 703 mengikat nilai select ke SKU state. Baris 748-752 membuang opsi jika SKU ditemukan pada seluruh slot terpilih, termasuk slot aktif. Pemeriksaan includes sensitif tipe string/number. Ini kandidat penyebab opsi aktif hilang sementara SKU tetap tersimpan.
- Baris 430-454: memilih -1 mereset SKU/quantity slot aktif dan berikutnya, serta mengembalikan quantity flavour sebelumnya. Ini menjelaskan mengapa workaround pengguna dapat membersihkan slot.
- Jalur reset lain memakai SKU 0 atau string kosong, sedangkan placeholder memakai -1. Normalisasi nilai kosong perlu diaudit bersama filter opsi.

Belum dibuktikan: reproduksi browser, versi production, tipe SKU runtime, payload transaksi, dan data DB. Jangan menganggap dua flavour terbukti tersimpan pada order tertentu.

Dampak usulan: perbaikan lokal state/select pada adapter E-Order, tetap memakai containerRuleEngine. Pertahankan opsi aktif, cegah duplikat hanya antar-slot, normalisasi kosong dan reset dependent fields. Tidak perlu perubahan schema. Implementasi belum dilakukan karena Kantor read-only dari workspace ini.

text:
# Backlog capability reusable HOTS dari Cineva dan Meetingbook

Rancangan 19 Oktober 2026, dokumentasi saja di Cineva. Tidak mengubah source/DB/Git/build/deploy/index HOTS Kantor. Tujuan: mengambil capability lintas vendor secara additive, bukan memindahkan seluruh program Cineva ke core.

## Bukti fondasi existing

Reference `programs/hots/meetingbook/module.json` mendokumentasikan HOTS service 13 sebagai source of truth, rooms pada resource_m_data, reminder PIC/creator dan create/cancel melalui engine HOTS. `routes/bookings.js` memberi read adapter untuk date/start_time/end_time dan menonaktifkan create langsung dengan 410. `services/hotsBookings.js` membaca ticket EAV. Frontend MeetingRoomStandalone sudah mengomposisi UI/form/Gantt. Pemeriksaan source ini bukan bukti runtime production atau audit seluruh aturan overlap.

## Daftar capability

Nama di bawah adalah usulan logical module; bukan instruksi membuat satu npm package per baris. Setiap module bisa memiliki engine backend, client contract dan komponen frontend sesuai kebutuhan. Reuse ticket/form/workflow/auth/document/trigger existing; hindari engine kedua untuk fungsi sama.

| ID | Prioritas | Capability | Isi umum | Adapter/policy domain |
|---|---|---|---|---|
| M01 | P1 | Calendar UI | Month/week/day/list, range, all-day, timezone, event/deadline, recurrence display | Meeting, visit, shoot, milestone, hotel occupancy |
| M02 | P1 | Resource & availability | Resource unit/type, capacity, operating hours, blackout, buffer, allocation, availability query | Ruang meeting, crew, gear, studio, kamar/unit atau tipe kamar |
| M03 | P1 | Reservation engine | Hold expiry, confirm/reschedule/cancel, overlap/capacity, idempotency, atomic allocation, ticket reference | Meeting service 13 adapter tetap; Cineva/hotel adapter baru |
| M04 | P1 | Workspace/access adapter | Server owner/member/role/resource scope dan tenant context ke engine | HQ/Creator, perusahaan/cabang/properti hotel; reuse IAM existing |
| M05 | P2 | Plan/milestone/assignment preset | Parent-child work, batches, multiple assignees, deliverables, deadlines | Campaign/talent, produksi, task lintas departemen; reuse assignment engine |
| M06 | P2 | Review/approval preset | Versioned submission, revision reason, approve/reject, audit, output references | QC creator, dokumen, desain; configure workflow engine existing |
| M07 | P2 | Quote/rate-card module | Configurable items/units, quantity, versioned quote snapshot, acceptance revision | Crew/gear/day, jasa, room-night; hotel revenue/yield rules bukan default core |
| M08 | P2 | Financial document/ledger adapter | Cash/non-cash separated, partial payments, immutable entries, evidence, provider port | Creator payout, deposit hotel, vendor invoice; bukan accounting/bank engine baru |
| M09 | P2 | Reminder/notification adapter | Schedule event, timezone, provider port, retry/dedup, cancel/reschedule behavior | Meeting reminder existing, deadline visit/QC, check-in reminder |
| M10 | P2 | Import/mapping/provenance adapter | Raw source + normalized values, type mapping, source cell, review conflicts, dry-run | Excel creator, guest/room imports; Lifestyle→niche adalah mapping domain |
| M11 | P3 | Portable demo/document export | Seed JSON, storage interface, offline HTML, import/export validation | Client trial/vendor demos; tidak mengganti persistence/auth production |
| M12 | P1/P3 | Shared UI/metadata extensions | Unique form IDs P1; semantic field renderers/tags/filtering/view composition P3 | Vendor labels/theme remain adapters; compare local forks before port |

Cross-cutting P1: expected revision/optimistic concurrency, immutable accepted snapshots, audit events, idempotency keys, schema validation, transaction + rollback. Ini kontrak yang dipakai beberapa modul, bukan harus satu engine/paket baru per guard.

## Kalender bukan reservasi

heading: Kalender bukan reservasi
text:
Event yang terlihat di kalender tidak otomatis memesan resource. Deadline/QC/insight dapat tanpa resource sama sekali. Reservation harus memeriksa kapasitas/overlap dalam operasi server atomik; frontend check tidak mencegah dua user memesan slot bersamaan.

Meeting/crew menggunakan interval waktu dan timezone/buffer. Hotel membutuhkan date-only stay dalam timezone properti, jumlah malam dan interval `[check_in, check_out)` sehingga hari checkout dapat menjadi check-in berikutnya. Room type inventory dengan quantity tidak sama dengan satu named meeting room. Hold, expiry, occupancy/maintenance, cancel/no-show, tarif/deposit/refund adalah policy adapter hotel; jangan menyamakan room_capacity tamu dengan jumlah kamar tersedia. Property pricing/pajak/regulasi belum dirancang atau diverifikasi di sini.

## Urutan dan acceptance

1. Audit & contract extraction Meetingbook: pertahankan service 13, EAV, create/cancel/envelope/approval/reminder. Buat adapter kompatibel dan tes baseline dummy sebelum refactor.
2. P1 calendar/resource/reservation + server access dan concurrency. Uji jam bersebelahan tidak bentrok, overlap ditolak, timezone, buffer/blackout, multi-resource all-or-nothing rollback, simultaneous confirmation, hold expiry, retries tidak menduplikasi.
3. Consumer kedua Cineva memakai deadline/visit/crew tanpa hardcode room. Consumer proof hotel dengan fixture sintetis unit/type inventory, consecutive stays, multi-night, quantity/capacity dan cancel release; bukan booking hotel production.
4. P2 assignment/QC/quote/ledger/reminder/import menggunakan engine existing serta extension contracts. Uji stale acceptance, snapshot lock, partial/overpay, cancel-reminder dedup dan raw/mapped data.
5. P3 demo export/layout extensions. Uji file URL offline, localStorage blocked fallback, edited HTML fresh browser, no external requests dan metadata compatibility.

Jangan membuat SQL dari daftar ini. Physical schema, service contract dan tenant policy harus diperiksa oleh project Kantor sebelum backend implementation. Semua tes memakai DB/fixture dummy; meeting room lama harus tetap lulus regresi. Sebagian capability sudah tersedia parsial; label kandidat bukan klaim semuanya belum ada. Implementasi Cineva saat ini banyak berupa frontend dummy/demo, bukan modul server yang tinggal dicopy.

# Cineva reusable package integration

Date: 2026-10-14 Asia/Jakarta. HOTS Kantor is read-only reference. This task changes Cineva only.

## Architectural impact

Frontend now uses an npm workspace rooted at `1.Frontend`: HOTS host, dynamic-form, service-form-runtime and `packages/*`. Fourteen package snapshots exist locally (13 frontend and transaction-kit backend). Seven frontend packages are consumed by app/tooling; the other six are available without invented business call sites. Backend transaction-kit is a catalog baseline only.

Generic components are owned by packages. Legacy imports remain thin compatibility entries; business behavior is injected from the app. Old implementations were retained in `3.Knowledge/_archive/package_upgrade_2026_10_14`. Reference package source snapshots/hashes are in `scripts/package_upgrade_2026_10_14/snapshot.json`; actual versions/status and current gap inventory are in `integration.json` and the Excel report.

## Changes implemented

- 53 generic UI modules now forward to `@hots/ui-kit/components/*`, including default exports where needed. `cn` and `useIsMobile` are shared. No generic implementation remains duplicated in those wrappers.
- `UnifiedFormStructureEditor` uses the shared visual builder, shared readonly renderer and service-form normalization. Stable IDs, unknown JSON properties, section children, structured rows and special metadata are retained by adapters. Legacy field/row-group/CMS/diagram settings stay optional advanced controls; unsupported new runtime field types cannot be created or selected through the shared inspector.
- `DataTableReportPro` uses the shared report renderer with host-controlled search, exact filters, shared include/exclude tags, numeric sorting and pagination. Filtering happens before paging. XLSX export includes all filtered loaded rows; PDF export stays compatible. Existing default/custom update request bodies are preserved, and failures propagate so editable cells restore their previous values.
- Added `HotsCoreProvider` with an explicitly injected app-owned transport. It resolves current API base and token per request and rejects cross-origin credential destinations. The shared cookie-only factory is not altered. Legacy auth remains until frontend/backend contracts are migrated together.
- Workflow, trigger and preference requests use typed engine-client APIs. Workflow responses preserve the existing `{ data }` wrapper; trigger list uses the backend's `function_type` and `is_active` parameters; preference cache/lifecycle remains app-owned.
- PDF wrapper consumes ui-kit media while retaining its download action. Optional peer resolution is configured in Vite and TypeScript. Tailwind scans shared packages and uses the shared preset while retaining app tokens.
- Shared eslint rules apply to new platform/form/report adapters. New files follow the modular engine/adapter separation; no new DB write or SQL migration was added.

## Explicit local forks

`ui-kit` 0.2.0-cineva.1 adds additive package export subpaths only. `table-engine` 0.2.0-cineva.1 fixes Escape → blur → save: the old draft was saved despite cancellation because state updates are asynchronous. A ref suppresses that blur save. It also adds optional `hideSearch` (default false) to preserve host-owned external search without an ignored internal input. The Office reference remains unchanged. Future synchronization must compare hashes and carry forward or retire these explicit patches; never overwrite forks blindly.

## Installation, indexing and retention

```powershell
npm.cmd run build:frontend
npm.cmd run dev:frontend
```
